remarks: Fabulous west facing end unit in desirable Hathaway Common Condominium in the heart of New Canaan. This well maintained condo has a light filled first with a spacious living room with two sets of French doors opening to the gracious patio, side yard and pool. The second floor has 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths and a finished lower level family room. There is a gracious foyer and attached garage. As an added bonus, there is a second detached garage perfect for a second car or storage. The garage is one of 8 detached garages in the complex. This is a must see home moments to everything New Canaan has to offer.
